source.title: Open problems in computational algebraic geometry

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH URL https://zbmath.org/806909. The local source list and zbMATH-indexed search metadata identify the exact work as David Eisenbud, 'Open problems in computational algebraic geometry', Zbl 0829.14030, published in Computational algebraic geometry and commutative algebra, Symposia Mathematica 34 (1993), pages 49-70.

failure_mode=metadata_only. Direct web reading of the zbMATH record did not expose a readable article body. Recovery attempts by exact title found David Eisenbud's papers index, a commalg.org survey link to the title, bibliographic references, and bookseller/catalog records, but these reachable pages contained only metadata or link lists rather than the article's problem statements.

failure_mode=missing_or_invalid_artifact. Candidate full-text PDF links from the author/survey route could not be resolved to readable PDF text in the available environment; shell curl attempts were blocked by DNS/network sandboxing, and the web reader did not return a parseable PDF artifact. The separate 2007 paper 'Some open problems in computational algebraic geometry' was rejected because it is a different work by Tanush Shaska.
No document map was created because no readable exact-work PDF or HTML full-text artifact was recovered.
Source adequacy gate failed: extracting questions from resolver metadata, bibliographic snippets, link labels, or a different later paper would violate the no-new-facts and source-adequacy rules.
Saved JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-806909.json and outputs/latest.json.
